inputs.text: These anti-Trump radicals kicked off their so-called "No Kings" rally by packing the streets in open defiance of established leadership and our national institutions. Federal officers had no choice but to deploy tear gas and carry out arrests to restore order after the volatile crowd turned the situation into chaos and forced authorities to issue dispersal orders. At least 13 arrests were confirmed in Portland and Denver. This is exactly the kind of predictable breakdown that occurs when left-wing agitators reject traditional authority and the rule of law, choosing disruption over the social order that has always protected our families, culture, and way of life.

output.main_topic: The No Kings rally and the law-enforcement response, framed as a challenge to authority that caused disorder.
subtopics: Deployment of tear gas and arrests
Criticism of left-wing opposition to traditional authority
